effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 4 cards from the top of your deck. Add 1 black Tamer card among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If you have 2 or more black Tamers in play, gain 1 memory.
